name: Michal Wiezik - Proposition de la Commission et amendements
title: REPORT on the proposal for a Directive of the European Parliament and of the Council on the conservation and sustainable use of marine biological diversity of areas beyond national jurisdiction
part_text:
The report sets out Parliament's position on a proposed law to apply a global ocean treaty inside the EU. The treaty covers the high seas, the waters beyond any country's control. The report tightens the draft to match the treaty's wording, adds public rights to information and to challenge decisions in court, and lets countries act fast in emergencies. It also stresses cooperation with fisheries bodies and existing EU environmental rules.

- **What changes:** clearer rules on environmental checks, protected sea areas and sharing benefits from marine resources.
- **Who it affects:** EU countries, fishing and shipping operators, scientists, and the public.
- **What happens next:** Parliament votes in plenary, then negotiates the final text with EU governments.
